start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapka din kaisa raha?

turns.reply: Kabir, sawaal mushkil lag raha hai, yeh normal hai. Pehle bas dekhiye: soft green stem herb ka, hard woody stem shrub ya tree ka. Kis mein hard woody stem hai?
Theek hai Kabir, aap chhodna chahte hain—koi pressure nahi. Aap carry on, short break, ya aaj ke liye stop chunenge?
Theek hai Kabir, neighbourhood walk mein tulsi ka stem soft hota hai, isliye tulsi herb hai. Aap kitchen mein ek herb pehchaaniye.
Kabir, yeh padhai ka pressure lag raha hai—ab sirf ek baat: soft green stem ko herb bolte hain. Aap bas ek naam bataiye.
Kabir, meri baat ulajh gayi thi; ab seedha: soft green stem herb ka hota hai. Aap herb ka ek naam bataiye.
Kabir, mummy ki daant se aap pareshaan lag rahe hain. Aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: main mar jaunga itna padh ke
turns.reply: Kabir, padhai ka pressure bahut zyada lag raha hai; abhi kitab band karke mummy ko bataiye ki aapko break chahiye—kya aap yahi kahenge?
